title: Bus Stop Standards of Student Transportation Services: Walking Distance, Stop Address and Stop Changes by Type
content:
Student Transportation Services places each rider's assigned stop within a set walking distance of the stop address, and limits how often a stop or stop address may change. The standards differ by transportation type.

## Walking distance and curb service

| Transportation type | Longest walk to the stop, grades PK3 through 05 | Longest walk to the stop, grades 06 through 12 | Stop at the residence or curb |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | 0.50 mile | 0.50 mile | no |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | 0.50 mile | 0.50 mile | no |
| Regular Route Eligibility | 0.25 mile | 0.50 mile | no |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | 0.25 mile | 0.50 mile | no |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | 0.00 mile | 0.00 mile | no |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | 0.25 mile | 0.50 mile | no |
| Special Education Transportation | 0.00 mile | 0.00 mile | yes, door-to-door |

A figure of 0.00 is the walking distance of a stop served without a walk (door-to-door service).

## Stop address

| Transportation type | Approved childcare address may replace the residence | Grades allowed an alternate address | Alternate address must lie in the attendance zone of the campus attended |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | no | none | yes |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | no | none | yes |
| Regular Route Eligibility | yes | KG, 01 through 05 | yes |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | yes | KG, 01 through 05 | yes |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | no | none | yes |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | yes | KG, 01 through 05 | yes |
| Special Education Transportation | yes | PK3, PK4, KG, 01 through 12 | no |

## Stop changes

| Transportation type | Same AM stop and same PM stop every school day | Completed stop or address changes per assignment per semester | Calendar days after the request until the new stop takes effect (request date is day 0) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | yes | 2 | 5 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | yes | 2 | 5 |
| Regular Route Eligibility | yes | 2 | 5 |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | yes | 2 | 5 |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | yes | 2 | 5 |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | yes | 6 | 3 |
| Special Education Transportation | yes | 2 | 5 |

## Examples (hypothetical riders)

- A kindergartner on Regular Route Eligibility walks no more than 0.25 mile to the stop; a seventh grader on the same type walks no more than 0.50 mile.
- A second grader on McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation may have up to 6 stop or address changes completed in a semester, each taking effect 3 calendar days after the request date.
